answer: The bundler ties his staves in bundles of twenty, and the tie must hold or the bundle falls apart on the cart. Barrel hazel stave jointer hoop bond governs the tying: a bond hazel stave jointers lodge after jointing bench trials. First the kernel ties at dawn, then the umber ties before the cart leaves, and the ferrous is the cart itself, piled high with bundles. A cheat must tie 61 false bundles and load 61 false carts.
